Bankrupt Dish Wireless Strikes $525 Million Settlement Deal With American Tower

The EchoStar subsidiary said it is in talks to settle with other tower owners, but Crown Castle, which has the largest claim, says it hasn’t been contacted

By

Dish Wireless struck a $525 million settlement with American Tower and said it is negotiating with other tower owners who claim they are owed billions of dollars as a result of the bankrupt company’s botched 5G network build-out.

Dish is working on similar settlements with other large creditors, including Charter Communications, which provided infrastructure and services the company used as it built out the 5G network, Dish said at a court hearing Wednesday.
